title: local-host node-suite tests starve past their waits under host load
body:
The same failure class this tick (kjs) fixed in workspace-checkpoints.test.ts exists in harness/test/node/local-host.test.ts, which kjs does not cover: its tests spawn a whole worker child process and wait on wall-clock conditions (waitFor, 30s bound) that a loaded shared host starves. Observed twice in one night while a live reconcile.test and an Xprotect scan ran beside: 'resumes from the storage after the harness is killed mid-tool, without re-running the tool' failed 'timed out waiting for the tool to be running' after 1040s, and an earlier run failed 'continues the SAME conversation when relaunched with a follow-up message' in the same file. Both pre-exist this tick's diff (the file is untouched by it) and both pass on a quiet host, so it is the host, not the tree — but per the repo's flaky-means-bug rule these tests need the same treatment kjs gave the workspace-checkpoints pair: a longer per-test timeout, and/or extending harness-timeout-discipline's guard to full-worker tests.
evidence: harness/test/node/local-host.test.ts:168 (waitFor throw) via :460; failure log of this attempt's run: 'timed out waiting for the tool to be running', test took 1040817ms at load average 23-47
demonstrating_check: cd harness && pnpm exec vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts test/node/local-host.test.ts
